g.text: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: the 40 backbone layers, from config.json
CSA2 ratio 2: one main KV entry per two tokens
CSA2 ratio 1: one entry per token, KV projected from the encoder output
decoder global KV is projected from the encoder's final hidden state (CED)
Full: computes main KV, indexer K, top-K
Reindex: own indexer Q, fresh top-K over the candidate pool
KV = owns a main KV cache (kv_source_layer_ids)
Grey bars above each row mark reuse groups; every layer also keeps its own 128-token sliding-window KV. Layer 20 additionally publishes the 16,384-position candidate pool the Reindex layers search.
